intake_summary: The packet was classified as a provisional architecture induction candidate about projection-driven organizational degrees of freedom. It was routed as a proposed induction-queue item and a proposed lexicon-review item, not as a formal induction or theorem-level claim.

candidate_work_items.title: Organizational degree-of-freedom and aspect-taxonomy lexicon review

warnings: The packet is internally coherent with current whole-expression and projection rules but does not supply a formal definition of organizational degree of freedom.
Existing projection-domain language in the textbook and math registries remains partial and is not closed by this intake alone.

Symmetry and asymmetry remain common governed vocabulary, but the proposed aspect taxonomy is still an open formalization task.
The packet does not alter RT_core, establish new theorems, or authorize projection-bridge promotion.
